meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 ast-grep,按代码的语法结构(而非文本)查找匹配形状的函数/调用/导入并批量改写;重写时默认先输出预览,确认后才实际修改文件。
howto.when: 当问题取决于代码形状而非文本时触发,例如“找所有形状像 X 的函数/调用”“把 console.log 批量改掉”“运行 YAML 规则上报违例”。

say.text: 找出项目里所有空 catch 块,列出文件和行号。
say.note: 按语法树识别,不按空行文本猜测。

say.text: 把全部 as any 去掉,先告诉我会影响哪些文件。
say.note: 它会给出匹配数与文件清单,确认后才重写。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses ast-grep to find or rewrite code by syntax structure rather than text: it matches functions/calls/imports shaped like the pattern, previews changes first, and writes files only after confirmation.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the question depends on code shape rather than text—e.g. find functions/calls shaped like X, rewrite console.log calls, or run YAML rules and report violations.

say_en.text: Change every console.log in src to logger.info—preview first, don't edit yet.
say_en.note: Claude will show a dry-run summary before applying.

say_en.text: Find all empty catch blocks in the project, with file and line.
say_en.note: Matches on the AST, not blank-line text.

say_en.text: Strip every as any and tell me which files are affected.
say_en.note: Claude reports match counts and files before rewriting.
